description: How much does sentry HP move the garrison's hold rate against the rush AI? 12 is the shipped value and the baseline; 9, 15 and 18 bracket it. What the table showed: 9 HP loses the outpost (about 10%), 12 holds it two games in three, 15 and 18 lock the raiders out entirely, and from 12 up the fight lasts the same six rounds (at 9 it ends a round sooner because sentries die first). The assertions pin the two ends of that so a sweep that stopped applying, or a garrison that stopped caring about HP, goes red; the middle is the sentry_hp_knee suite's question.
